description: Upgrade plan to migrate project to Java 25

tasks.reason: Java 25 is the latest LTS release and brings significant performance improvements, new language features (pattern matching, records, sealed classes), and enhanced security. Upgrading ensures long-term support, access to modern APIs, and alignment with the current Java ecosystem.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade the JDK/Java compiler and runtime target to Java 25. Update build tool configuration (Maven or Gradle) to set the Java source and target compatibility to 25. Review and address any deprecated or removed APIs, and resolve any compilation warnings or errors introduced by the new Java version.
tasks.summary: Upgraded the project from Java 21 to Java 25. Updated pom.xml java.version to 25 and Dockerfile base images to eclipse-temurin:25. Build and tests pass successfully.
